_what: The derivation's two hand-written judgement calls, as DATA with reasons — read by scripts/derive-coverage.mjs (the audit:derivation gate) and bundled into cli/data/forge.json by gen-forge-data.ts, so the gate and the forge cannot disagree.
_overlap: The layers OVERLAP: Open UI lists 'Textarea' and GOV.UK lists 'Text input' as components, and both ARE the platform's elements — the floor styles them and nothing has to be built. name-form (normalised like audit:naming) → the element it is. GOV.UK's field-level patterns (names, emails, phone numbers, bank details, NI numbers) prescribe the PLAIN element — a single text input; Telephone numbers explicitly says: no country-code picker. APG's Disclosure pattern IS <details>/<summary>.
_decided: Core catalogue entries deliberately NOT shipped, with the reason written down rather than left as a hole. The derivation gate accepts these as covered; the forge answers with the reason.

decided.Treegrid: a tree crossed with a grid — rows that expand AND cells that navigate. No service system publishes one; a tax form needs a table or a tree, not both at once. Not shipped, on purpose.
decided.Logo: a brand asset, not a component. The header has a slot for it; there is nothing to style.

_tokenCovered: Catalogue entries covered by the TOKEN system rather than a component: an icon is the iconSet knob plus size tokens, not a recipe. name → the tokens that cover it.
